text:
jamie (sales): Heads-up — SparkBank wants to kick off a 4-week POC next week. Primary blockers: SAML SSO, SCIM for provisioning, RBAC mapping, and domain controls. They also asked about dedicated pricing and audit logs.
eli (solutions): Got it. Do they have an IdP already? (Okta / Azure?)
jamie (sales): Okta + custom app. They specifically called out automatic group sync and SCIM custom attributes for 'employee_type' and 'cost_center'.
anya (security): Need to confirm SCIM attribute support and SCIM provisioning SCIM v2 payloads. Also they want SAML signed assertions + SP-initiated flow. Send their security questionnaire sooner rather than later.
kevin (eng): From runtime side SCIM + group sync is fine. Two notes: 1) Our SCIM mutating attributes are limited to core (name, email, groups) unless we map custom attributes via our transform layer. 2) For RBAC they want nested group -> role mapping, which is not supported out of the box in the console (we support flat group->role today).
jamie (sales): Can we scope the POC to deliver SAML SSO + SCIM core fields and show a path for custom attrs? If nested groups is a no-go, they'd need a workaround.
eli (solutions): Proposal: POC scope = SAML (Okta SAML app, SP-initiated), SCIM core attributes + one custom mapped attribute (cost_center) via transform, RBAC via flat groups. Also include audit log demo and token rotation docs.
anya (security): For the security questionnaire answers I need the following artifacts: IdP metadata example, SCIM endpoint URL + TLS cert chain, SOC2 statement link (we have non-prod controls docs), and a sample audit log entry format.
jamie (sales): I'll ask SparkBank for IdP metadata and the questionnaire today. ETA: EOD.
kevin (eng): For the transform mapping we can prototype a small webhook that rewrites SCIM payloads to add employee_type -> custom:employeeType. Example snippet we can demo:
```json
POST /scim/v2/Users
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:CreateRequest"],
  "userName": "jdoe@sparkbank.com",
  "name": {"givenName": "John", "familyName": "Doe"},
  "emails": [{"value": "jdoe@sparkbank.com", "primary": true}],
  "customAttributes": {"employeeType": "contractor", "costCenter": "001-ops"}
}
```
eli (solutions): @anya if we map one custom attribute can you accept that as a mitigating control for the questionnaire? We'll document the roadmap for full SCIM schema support.
anya (security): Possibly. I need a risk note: custom attr mapping is manual transform and not enforced by IdP. Also ask SparBank if they require provisioning deprovisioning speed SLA (<5 mins). That changes throttling config.
jamie (sales): They said near-realtime deprovisioning is important. Also pricing — they asked about Dedicated node pricing for POC vs hosted. Any quick numbers?
kevin (eng): For a 4-week POC on Dedicated, rough: 2 x A100-equivalent reserved for the month -> ops team will price. For hosted, usage-based estimate we can give: token rates + concurrency guarantees. I'll ping finance for a formal quote.
eli (solutions): Action items: 1) jamie get IdP metadata + questionnaire; 2) kevin prototype SCIM transform demo (by Wed); 3) anya draft security answers + risk notes (by Thu); 4) jamie collect pricing ask and confirm deprovisioning SLA.
jamie (sales): I'll lock calendar for kickoff Mon 09:00 PT and cc the customer's IdP engineer.
infra-bot: Reminder — schedule created: POC-kickoff-sparkbank created and calendar invites sent.
kevin (eng): One engineering blocker to call out: if they want SAML encrypted assertions + signed, our SDK supports signing but encryption for assertions requires extra key exchange. Need customer to provide SP encryption cert or allow signing-only.
jamie (sales): Noted. I'll check if they require encrypted assertions or signing-only.
eli (solutions): If they ask for nested groups we can offer a short-term workaround: a sync job that expands nested groups into flat groups during provisioning. We'll include that in the POC addendum.
anya (security): Also requesting log retention policy for POC: SparkBank wants 12 months with access controls. We only store logs for 90 days by default on hosted. For Dedicated/private we can extend — include that in SLA convo.
jamie (sales): Good point — adding log retention to the pricing + contract checklist.
kevin (eng): Quick note on domain controls: they want to lock signups to @sparkbank.com. That's trivial via our tenant allowlist. We'll demo in the console.
eli (solutions): Sounds like we have a plan. Jamie I'll prepare a short one-pager with scope and known blockers to share with the customer.
jamie (sales): Perfect. I'll send the one-pager after I get the IdP metadata. :thumbsup:
anya (security): If they send the questionnaire now I can start filling it out this afternoon.
jamie (sales): Sending now — attaching in thread.
eli (solutions): Great — keeping thread updated.
jamie (sales): (external) SparkBank IdP metadata received from their SRE. Next steps: map attributes and confirm encrypted assertion requirement.
kevin (eng): Received metadata, beginning compatibility check.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: config-check OK for SCIM endpoint demo.
ani (security): Typo in participants: that's anya :)
anya (security): All good — thanks.
